name: motifpath-specs
description: Contract repository for the MotifPath platform: OpenAPI specs, event schemas, Gherkin features, ADRs, and AI prompts.

scripts.validate:features: bash -c 'find features -name "*.feature" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d "" f; do echo "Validating $f..."; npx @cucumber/gherkin-streams "$f" > /dev/null; done'
scripts.validate: npm run validate:openapi && npm run validate:features
